notes.title: Sumatra: Fate of Yandi has been nominated for 2 Aggie Awards! + Reader's Choice Poll
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We are very proud to announce that [b]Sumatra: Fate of Yandi[/b] has been nominated for 2 awards in the [url=https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/39492]2019 Aggie Awards[/url]! Big thanks to the lovely folk over at Adventure Gamers for this honour.

Sumatra: Fate of Yandi has been nominated in the following categories:
- Best Story
- Best Traditional Adventure

You can also vote for Sumatra: Fate of Yandi in the [url=https://advhttps://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/39493enturegamers.com/articles/view/39492]Reader's Choice poll![/url] Any votes are much appreciated. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/610900/Sumatra_Fate_of_Yandi/

Thanks for your support!
Shaun
[i]Cloak and Dagger Games[/i]

notes.title: A little update
notes.content:
Hey all,

It recently came to my attention that the copyright status of a song featured in A Date in the Park had changed - so unfortunately I've had to remove the song from the game for the time being.

On the flip side, this also gave me the opportunity to rebuild the game in an updated version of the engine - meaning it should now run a little smoother on Steam and you can switch between full screen and windowed mode by pressing Alt+Enter.

Please note: the update may mean old save game files will not work anymore. If you were part way through the game you may need to start over - apologies!! This is due to engine limitations that mean save games can be broken when the game is updated.

Thanks for your support!
Shaun
[b][i]Cloak and Dagger Games[/i][/b]

notes.title: Our new game is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Our new game, Football Game, is OUT NOW! 

Football Game is something of a spiritual successor to A Date in the Park - if you're a fan of ADITP I think you might like this one too :) 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/654550/Football_Game/

[b]Story[/b]
East Bend, Purchase County. 1987.
You are Tommy, a local high school football hero in the town of East Bend. It’s game night for the Purchase County Turbines and your sweetheart is waiting in the bleachers. Join Tommy for a night you won’t forget...

Something is amiss...

[b]Features[/b]
- A traditional point and click adventure game aesthetic with puzzles and dialogue interactions familiar to the genre.
- A cast of characters including friends, foes, teachers, and a concerned mother.
- A short, twisted narrative with approximately 45 minutes to an hour of gameplay, depending on the player.
- Original soundtrack by UK duo JUPITER-C, which will also be available on cassette.

[b]Inspiration?[/b]
Traditional point and click adventure games from the '80s and '90s, the music and films of David Lynch, the uncanny.

notes.title: An update on our next game on Greenlight
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Thanks for all you support with out latest game on Greenlight - the point and click mystery/thriller [b]Football Game[/b] - we had a nice little surge in votes recently which has put us up above 300 yes votes in total. 

We've got a healthy Yes/No ratio so hopefully the game might be Greenlit soon - in the meantime, if you haven't checked out the game, your vote is much appreciated, we need all the help we can get! If you were a fan of [b]A Date in the Park[/b] I think you will like this one too, it has a similar vibe. 

You can check the Greenlight page out here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=899201612

The game features an original soundtrack from one of my favourite bands, JUPITER-C - check out their latest video here to hear the kind of musical flavour the game will have:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JedkB5-VV6M

Many thanks for your support!

Shaun
[b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b]

notes.title: Sumatra - our new game on Steam Greenlight!
notes.content:
From the makers of A Date in the Park, Mudlarks and The Terrible Old Man comes SUMATRA, an all new jungle adventure!

Your votes are appreciated! http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=864100054

What's the story?

You are Yandi, a villager who works for the Pandang Logging Company deep in the Sumatran jungle. An accident leaves you stranded and alone. You must survive, you must escape. Along the way you'll meet a multitude of jungle beasts, tribes-people, scientists and nefarious loggers. Can Yandi get out alive?

What are the features?

- An old school point and click adventure aesthetic with puzzles galore
- A range of interesting characters, including Kubu tribespeople and creatures unique to the Sumatran jungle
- A variety of subplots to keep Yandi on his toes as he tries to escape the jungle
- Playable flashback sequences that paint a picture of where Yandi has come from and how his attitudes have formed
- Cool 8-bit soundtrack
- Mystery, intrigue and surprise! Uncover secrets along the way
- Decision-making elements
- 3+ hours of game play

Inspiration?

Old school point and click adventures from the 80s (eg Kings Quest, Space Quest), Pitfall, Jungle King. Myths and legends of Indonesia. 

Wait, this looks a little familiar!

Sumatra is an expanded version of our well received free game from 2015, Pendek. While Pendek had around 20-30 minutes of gameplay, Sumatra will feature at least 3 hours of adventuring, with many added situations, plot-lines and characters.

When can I play?

If Greenlit, Sumatra will be available within a couple of months.

How much will it cost?

Sumatra will be at the budget end of the scale, probably around £2.80/$3.50

notes.title: A Date in the Park - Collector's Edition DLC is on sale! 40% off
notes.content:
[b]A Date in the Park - Collector's Edition DLC is 40% off for the next few days, the biggest discount yet![/b]

What's in the DLC?

- A piece of writing detailing the making of the game and the thought processes behind it. (Spoilers contained! We recommend finishing the game before looking at the DLC extras) 
- PDFs featuring original photographs used for backgrounds and sprites, including many background images which didn't make it into the final version of the game. 
- 2 short music tracks that were made for the game but did not feature. 
- [b]A short bonus game called "aerinde".[/b] Made in a similar graphical style to A Date in the Park, this is a short (approximately 10-20 minutes) first-person point and click mystery game now only available as part of this Collector's Edition. Your name is G. After an old friend gives you the chance of a new life, it's time to return the favour. Note adult themes and situations are explored, including depictions of drug use. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/542380/

notes.title: Collector's Edition DLC now available!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Thanks for your continued support of our little game, we're glad you're enjoying it!

Due to free games not remaining in a player's Steam library after uninstalling, we've created a Collector's Edition DLC with some additional content for those who want to keep it in their collection. Or perhaps for those who wish to support our team, or for those who would like to gain a little more insight into the game's creation. 

There are no new achievements with this DLC, to ensure that all players can 100% complete the game with just the free version. 

You can see it here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/542380. It's 10% off for the first week. The normal cost is 79p/99c

It includes: 

- A piece of writing detailing the making of the game and the thought processes behind it. 
- PDFs featuring original photographs used for backgrounds and sprites, including many background images which didn't make it into the final version of the game. 
- 2 short music tracks that were made for the game but did not feature. 
- A short bonus game called "aerinde". Made in a similar graphical style to A Date in the Park, this is a short (approximately 10-20 minutes) first-person point and click mystery game now only available as part of this Collector's Edition. Your name is G. After an old friend gives you the chance of a new life, it's time to return the favour. Note adult themes and situations are explored, including depictions of drug use. 

Note that these extra features are currently only available in English!

If you are interested, we hope you enjoy the extra content.

Thanks,

Shaun 
Cloak and Dagger Games
